rule.text: Tent and RV sites can be reserved up to 6 months in advance, and group sites can be reserved up to 12 months in advance. To reserve a site please call the National Recreation Reservation Service at (877) 444-6777 or make reservations through Recreation.gov. For more information, please call the Pinn
